status.description: done: the end state is reached. partial: some of it, the rest named in summary. blocked: stopped on a boundary or ambiguity, see blocked_actions. failed: could not do it.

summary.description: What was done and what was found, in a few sentences. Claims about files cite path:line.

artifacts.description: Paths (or branch@sha for a writer) of everything the task produced. Empty for a pure read.

blocked_actions.description: Each action that was denied or that the brief forbade, as '<intent>: <action> (<why>)'. Empty when nothing was blocked.
